name: less
description: A pager that views files one screen at a time with scrolling, searching, and navigation — without loading the whole file into memory.

flags.description: Follow mode: stream new content like tail -f, press Ctrl+C to stop and navigate.
Chop long lines instead of wrapping them.

examples.explanation: Opens the log in a pager. Navigate with arrows, Page Up/Down, g (top), G (end).
Follows the file like tail -f but lets you press Ctrl+C to scroll back through history, then F to resume following.
Inside less: searches forward for "error". Press n for the next match, N for the previous one. Press q to quit.

about: less is the modern successor to more. It loads only what it displays, so it opens gigabyte-sized files instantly. Common in-pager keys: Space/PageDown forward, b back, /pattern search, ?pattern reverse search, v open in $EDITOR, q quit, -S toggle line chopping.
useCases: View man pages (man uses less by default).
Follow growing logs while retaining scrollback.
mistakes: Typing exit to leave less — the quit key is q.
Losing colors when piping into less; use less -R or ls --color=always | less -R.
